Oliver — thanks for the fast turnaround and the spreadsheet. A few clarifications to help us map to DEAL-3219 milestones:

1) Can you break the quote into three line items tied to delivery windows (M1: first wave, M2: bulk, M3: final trim)? That will let legal and procurement map payments to the contract milestones.
2) We need explicit lead-time SLAs per lot (max days between final acceptance of drawings and ship date) and a clear list of which components are at risk for lead-time variance.
3) Is there any ability to replace the expedited premium with a delivery escrow (e.g., partial payout + capacity guarantee) — procurement prefers structured remedies versus simple percentage penalties.

Also cc'ing Emma Li (PlutoAI) so the customer sees the options and can confirm whether partial shipments are acceptable for their staging plan. Ben/Karthik — please review and flag any gating items (customs, test image requirements, or special firmware build requests).

We will aim to confirm a decision to hold expedited slots (if needed) by Feb 17 to match your timeline.

Best,

Thanks Tessa — quick internal read and recommended procurement posture for DEAL-3219:

Summary recommendations (draft):
- Hedge: split commitment across OEM expedited lane (40% of units) + cloud reserved backstop (50%) + standard OEM queue (10%). This reduces single-supplier exposure and matches expected onramp curve.
- Deposit structure: push for milestone-based deposits tied to M1/M2. Avoid a full 50% upfront if we can secure an escrow or capacity hold clause.
- Acceptance criteria: require test image snapshots and burn-in logs for first two lots; include a 14-day cure window for any hardware failures that arise during staging.

Action items:
- Ben: confirm customs clearance lead times for EU -> US cross-ship (we may need port buffer).
- Lauren: if you can quick-approve a capped expedited premium range (up to 12%) we can lock Feb 17 hold with Oakridge.

Team — quick alignment and final procurement plan for DEAL-3219. Decided path:

1) Commitments
- OEM expedited lane: 40% of ordered units (commit to hold by Feb 17). Deposit structure: 25% on expedited tranche, 25% on M1 shipment.
- Cloud reserved backstop: reserve 50% capacity via AWS DocuSign packet; target provisioning 2028-03-20.
- Standard OEM queue: keep 10% in the standard Q2 tranche as insurance.

2) Acceptance and QA
- Oakridge to provide burn-in logs + firmware build for first two lots; Redwood QA will run a 72-hour system soak before handing to PlutoAI staging.
- Any critical failures discovered during soak will trigger the 14-day cure window in the acceptance criteria.

3) Logistics & customs
- Ben: lead customs clearance booking by Feb 20; if delays >7 days we escalate to logistics partner.
- Karthik: draft deposit/escrow language and send to Lauren for legal sign-off.

4) Timeline artifacts and links
- Procurement plan (attached): deal-3219-procurement-plan.csv
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/DEAL-3219
- DocuSign packet: https://docusign.com/packet/ZX9A12-PLUTO-DEAL

Thanks — we should be in a good position to meet PlutoAI's onramp if we execute these steps.
